entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:1
segments: ¶To every [thing there is] a season, and a time to every purpose under the heaven:

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:2
segments: A time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up [that which is] planted; {to be...: Heb. to bear}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:3
segments: A time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:4
segments: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:5
segments: A time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing; {to refrain from: Heb. to be far from}

words.text: ; {to refrain from: Heb. to be far from}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:6
segments: A time to get, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away; {get: or, seek}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:7
segments: A time to rend, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:8
segments: A time to love, and a time to hate; a time of war, and a time of peace.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:9
segments: What profit hath he that worketh in that wherein he laboureth?

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:10
segments: I have seen the travail, which God hath given to the sons of men to be exercised in it.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:11
segments: ¶He hath made every [thing] beautiful in his time: also he hath set the world in their heart, so that no man can find out the work that God maketh from the beginning to the end.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:12
segments: I know that [there is] no good in them, but for [a man] to rejoice, and to do good in his life.

words.text: in them, but for [a man] to rejoice

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:13
segments: And also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy the good of all his labour, it [is] the gift of God.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:14
segments: I know that, whatsoever God doeth, it shall be for ever: nothing can be put to it, nor any thing taken from it: and God doeth [it], that [men] should fear before him.

words.text: to it, nor any thing taken

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:15
segments: That which hath been is now; and that which is to be hath already been; and God requireth that which is past. {that which is past: Heb. that which is driven away}

words.text: That which hath been is now
; and that which is to be hath already
. {that which is past: Heb. that which is driven away}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:16
segments: ¶And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, [that] wickedness [was] there; and the place of righteousness, [that] iniquity [was] there.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:17
segments: I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked: for [there is] a time there for every purpose and for every work.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:18
segments: I said in mine heart concerning the estate of the sons of men, that God might manifest them, and that they might see that they themselves are beasts. {that God...: or, that they might clear God, and see, etc}

words.text: them, and that they might see
. {that God...: or, that they might clear God, and see, etc}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:19
segments: For that which befalleth the sons of men befalleth beasts; even one thing befalleth them: as the one dieth, so dieth the other; yea, they have all one breath; so that a man hath no preeminence above a beast: for all [is] vanity.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:20
segments: All go unto one place; all are of the dust, and all turn to dust again.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:21
segments: Who knoweth the spirit of man that goeth upward, and the spirit of the beast that goeth downward to the earth? {of man: Heb. of the sons of man} {goeth upward: Heb. is ascending, etc}

words.text: ? {of man: Heb. of the sons of man} {goeth upward: Heb. is ascending, etc}

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 3:22
segments: Wherefore I perceive that [there is] nothing better, than that a man should rejoice in his own works; for that [is] his portion: for who shall bring him to see what shall be after him?
